### Meaning
| infl. | class | meaning                                                         |
| ----- | ----- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*  | change, transformation, metamorphosis                           |
| ~en   | *v.*  | to become, turn into, transform into (tr.), to change (in/tr.), |
### Implied meaning
- chemical reaction (Chinese meaning)
### Etymology
#### Glyph
化, two people facing opposite sides, mirrored.
#### Note
==Chen== is a type of bakeneko. Bakeneko are cat youkai known for their *shapeshifting* abilities ;)
#### Sound
- *a priori:* ch=sudden/transformative, en=process/flexible
